The awaited result is consumed by the immediately following validation/preparation step; it is a data dependency. JsxStudioRunPanel awaits compilation before reading compiler diagnostics and prepared source. Moving this await later would access an unresolved compile result and cannot preserve diagnostic/preview ordering.
